description: This file defines a React component called NoteEditor, which provides a user interface for editing, saving, and deleting notes. It manages local state, handles debounced save operations, and interacts with an external API for persistence.

methods.name: NoteEditor
methods.description: React component to edit notes with explicit save and delete options, managing local state and API interactions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the note data if not initially provided.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles user input changes for the note's title or content.

methods.name: maybeBlurSave
methods.description: Sets a timeout to save the note when focus is lost, respecting debounce settings.

methods.name: doSave
methods.description: Performs an optimistic save of the note, with rate-limiting and error handling.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the current note and redirects to the notes list.
